rows.grounds: compound mūla-bāla-ālaya-ukta; instrumental form qualifying vidhinā
instrumental of vidhi indicating the prescribed procedure
compound ālaya-nirṇaya; subject of the clause

items.question: What prescribed procedure governs the determination of a shrine?
premises: A method is stated for the root and child shrines.
This stated method functions as the governing procedure.
The determination of a shrine follows that procedure.
items.inference: Therefore, the determination of a shrine is governed by the method stated for the root and child shrines.
items.plain_english: The determination of a shrine is to be made by the method stated for the root and child shrines.
